_comment: Mapping from the item name in the TW/AGT raw file to the item code used in the ND SOH report. The app adds entries here when you answer an unmatched item.

_notes.BUDS 4 AIR: TW raw puts the market name in the Item column and the code in Market Name - they are swapped. VALIDATED 6 weeks (Jul 27 - Aug 20): 'BD04 Air' is in every roster, 'BUDS 4 AIR' is in none.
_notes.T1002: TW sometimes writes a bare T1002 with no variant. VALIDATED 6 weeks: T1002 128+4 was 0 in every report from Jul 27 to Aug 10 while T1002 256+4 held all the stock (520 on Jul 27, then 6,000). 'T1002' itself is never a roster row. WATCH: on Aug 20 the split changed to 3,000 / 5,480 - and there TW wrote the two variants as separate rows, so the bare form has so far only appeared when the stock was all 256+4. If a bare T1002 ever shows up while 128+4 also has stock, stop and ask TW how it splits.
_notes.TSP-W03A / TSP-WP03A: Same watch, spelled two ways. Roster used TSP-W03A for 5 straight weeks (Jul 27 - Aug 10) then switched to TSP-WP03A on Aug 20. TW raw writes TSP-W03A; AGT raw writes TSP-WP03A. Declared as an equivalence group so the app maps onto whichever form the current roster uses.
